s.note: Chilled ripe strawberries with sugar for dipping, cold sparkling wine alongside
s.how: Wash and properly dry 500g of the ripest strawberries and chill. Pile them into a glass bowl with a tiny dish of caster sugar for dipping. Open a very cold bottle of sparkling wine alongside.

s.note: Baked in garlic, shallot and brandy butter until sizzling, snails or mushroom caps
s.how: Put 20 button mushroom caps or escargot in a baking dish. Mash 100g butter with 3 garlic cloves, parsley, a chopped shallot and a splash of brandy and cover each one. Bake at 200C for 10 minutes until sizzling. Serve with baguette.

m.n: Business dinner eye fillet and red wine jus
m.note: Seared eye fillet in red wine jus, with creamy potato gratin
m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream, a crushed garlic clove and salt, and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Sear an 800g eye fillet on all sides, roast at 200C to 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Soften 2 chopped shallots, add 250ml red wine and reduce by half, then add 300ml beef stock and reduce until glossy. Whisk in 20g butter. Steam 300g green beans and toss with butter.

w.note: Strawberries dipped in dark chocolate with a white chocolate drizzle
w.how: Wash and completely dry 500g strawberries. Dip each in 200g melted dark chocolate and set on baking paper. Drizzle thin lines of 50g melted white chocolate across them and chill until set.

d.note: Champagne over a bitters soaked sugar cube with a splash of brandy
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of champagne in an ice bucket for 30 minutes. Drop a sugar cube into each of four flutes and soak with 2 dashes of aromatic bitters. Add 15ml brandy to each, then slowly top with champagne. Twist a strip of orange peel over each glass and drop it in.
